versions.notes:
- The workshop now has its own art: a picture for every item and facility, the season's backdrop and workshop scene, emotion marks in stories, the wooden title sign, and paper, wood and button panels. A picture that cannot load falls back to the drawn look.
- 설정 → 표시 → 계절: follow today's date or pick spring, summer, autumn or winter. Only the current season's pictures are loaded; the season changes the look only.
- Story emotions are now joy, affection, curiosity, fluster, inspiration and annoyance; scenes written earlier keep showing with the nearest mark.

- Fixed: a late heartbeat or read could put an older revision of the world back on screen, and an answer for a world you had left could replace the one you opened. Updates now apply only to the same world and never go backwards; opening a world drops answers from an earlier navigation.
- Fixed: once the 72-hour absence budget was used, background reads on later days kept auto-selling. The workshop now stays frozen until you return; a return or a command still re-evaluates at once.

- 탐사 → 이야기 탐험: each pair goes through arcs of three episodes. Episode 1 needs one resident, 2 and 3 need both; the next opens after the previous is read. Expeditions take 30–90 minutes of workshop time (the 72-hour rule applies), use up to two preparations and can be cancelled with everything returned.
- Reading a scene for the first time asks your language model to write it from the stored plan and only the memories its residents share. A refused or failed answer stores nothing; retry the same plan at no cost.
- The reader: emotion marks, backlog, auto, and one answer to a resident's question (it raises that resident's trust and only they remember it). Reading records what the residents learned and changes the pair a little.
- Backups now carry the written scenes.

- More to make: 15 materials (pinecones, acorns, pumpkins, cotton, tea leaves, beeswax, feathers, four-leaf clovers…), 8 processed goods and 11 finished goods, with longer chains such as cotton → thread → scarf or tea → herb tea → gift box. More delivery requests use them.
- A resident's field and talent are now decided when they are registered, read from their own character or persona text, and shown before you confirm; they no longer change afterwards. Each talent speeds up one recipe of that field or saves one input.
- Existing residents keep a field you already chose and get a matching talent; others get both from their stored source text.

- Five facilities, one per field; 재배밭, 조사대 and 제작대 open once their condition is met. New materials and goods.
- 지정 횟수: a facility can run a queue (1–99 runs per request, 3–5 slots by level) instead of its rules; switching lets the current run finish.
- Residents get a field you choose and speed up a facility of that field (5%, up to 10% with breakthroughs); a pair placed together adds a small bonus everywhere.
- 자동 판매 per item, off by default: never below your amount, the production target or protected stock, at most your daily amount per UTC day.
- 초대: 1 or 10 invitations with tickets, equal chances (a wished resident more), breakthroughs, tokens and a chosen-resident exchange, with a guarantee, 확률 보기 and 초대 기록.
- Tickets come from the starter kit and daily delivery requests. Worlds that already claimed the kit get its tickets once.

- Automatic production: a gathering yard and a processing bench run on their own from recommended rules (target stock, priority, on/off). Change targets and order on the Work screen and apply them; 추천 설정 previews the recommended rules first.
- Production is measured against stock plus what is already being made, may finish at most one batch over a target, and never uses protected stock. A waiting facility says why (materials, protected amount, target reached).
- Time away counts for at most 72 hours per absence, however often the world is opened in the background; a run cut at that edge keeps its remaining time until you return. Only the visible, focused game screen counts as being present.
- Facility upgrades for gold (faster runs from the next run), stock protection, selling from the storeroom, and the 작업 보고 on Home (reading it never grants anything twice).

- Screens follow the final mockups: Home, Work, Facilities and Storeroom, Settings and Save · Backup, with parts that open in later phases kept in place and marked 준비 중.
- Residents: register your characters and personas into a world. The source is only read; its text is kept beside the resident's new 공방 세계 설정 for comparison, with a change history. The same source is always one resident. A persona resident is an inhabitant, never the player.
- Optional 다시 제안 asks your default language model for a setting draft; nothing is saved until you confirm.
- Choose one starting resident. Pair any two residents — character or persona, in any combination (one resident may be in several pairs); archive and restore pairs.
- Resident pictures are your own PNG or static WebP uploads, stored as quality 95 WebP with transparency. Size, position and marker height are saved separately; the last 3 pictures can be restored.
- Backups now carry the WebP pictures and restore them under new gallery IDs.

- Worlds: create several, switch between them, rename the world and your nickname. The player has a nickname only.
- Every change is a command the server decides; a resent command never applies twice, and a failed save changes nothing.
- One-time welcome package and the storeroom with gold and materials.
- JSON backup without secrets; restoring always makes a new world and leaves the original untouched.
- The connection checks moved to Settings → 연결 점검.

- P0 connection check build. Not the game yet: a Home tab that proves the Engine connections the game will use.
- Reads characters and personas without writing them, resolves a model connection and fits a context without generating.
- Proves package document revisions, stale-write rejection and transaction rollback with temporary documents.
- Stores an uploaded PNG or static WebP resident picture as a quality 95 WebP in the Global Gallery and keeps only its reference. The PNG original is not kept.
